scope: Automatic cited post-event reviews use the local evidence generator; this release does not remove every optional or legacy AI path.

scheduledWorkerVerification.note: This third batch was dispatched by the restarted normal scheduler without manual invocation. Historical failure totals are retained.

countingNote: Initial and final forecasts have separate immutable review versions; 15 versions does not mean 15 distinct fixtures.
